This mirror converts them to Cloud Optimized GeoTIFFs with overviews and embedded statistics. It is a derived, lossy product: pixel values are quantized to 0.01 persons per cell and are not bit-identical to JRC's distribution. The grid, model, inputs, authors, and licence are unchanged. title: Philadelphia Housing and Land Use
summary: Ten collections describing property, zoning, vacancy, and affordable housing in Philadelphia, mirrored from the City of Philadelphia's ArcGIS services via [OpenDataPhilly](https://opendataphilly.org/). Together they answer what exists on a parcel, what the zoning code permits there, whether the city believes it is empty, and what publicly funded housing has been built.  The catalog holds 1,780,845 features. Property parcels (607,957), land use (559,077), and building footprints (546,083) cover the whole city. Zoning base districts (29,205) and overlays (195) record what the code allows, and a 39-row lookup table decodes every zoning code. The city's vacancy model flags 28,737 likely-vacant lots and 9,041 likely-vacant buildings. Affordable housing production lists 501 DHCD-funded projects delivering 19,249 units since 1994.  Each collection ships as GeoParquet in the source CRS, EPSG:3857, with PMTiles for rendering and two to three verified map styles. Start at the catalog [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for join keys, worked queries, and the data quirks that cause most wrong answers.

summary: Canada's Orthoimages 2005-2010 is the national medium-resolution imagery coverage of Canada. These digital raster data acquired by the Spot4 and Spot5 satellites comprise five spectral bands.

title: Sentinel 3 Level 2+3 on AWS
summary: Observations from the Sentinel-3 satellite of the European Commission’s Copernicus Earth Observation Programme, available in Level 2 and 3. Hosted on AWS.

title: Sentinel 5P Level 2 on AWS
summary: Observations from the Sentinel-5 Precursor (Sentinel-5P) satellite of the European Commission’s Copernicus Earth Observation Programme. Hosted on AWS.

title: Sentinel Hub
summary: Sentinel Hub Catalog is an API implementing the STAC Specification, describing geospatial information about different data used with Sentinel Hub.
accessInfo: The Sentinel Hub API uses OAuth2 Authentication and requires that you have an access token. See the [Authentication chapter](https://docs.sentinel-hub.com/api/latest/api/overview/authentication/) for more information.

title: Sentinel-1 RTC CONUS
summary: Sentinel1 radiometric terrain corrected backscatter (RTC) over CONUS since 2017. These radar data have been processed from original GRD scenes into a Radiometrically Terrain Corrected, tiled product suitable for analysis.

title: SkyServe Mission Data
summary: This will be a collection of sample raster data for skyserve missions

title: Soft Commodity Infrastructure (Brazil)
summary: This is the geolocated midstream of Brazilian agriculture: the silos, slaughterhouses, dairy plants, and sugar/ethanol mills that farms sell into, plus the cooperatives that farms belong to. It exists to answer, for any rural property, **who to contact** about deforestation on the land — the cooperative that has the farmer as a member, or the buyer that receives their grain, cattle, or cane.

title: South American Rural Cadastral Boundaries
summary: Cadastral parcel boundaries for South American rural land use and supply chain analysis. Intended for use alongside Trazo agricultural field boundaries and Fields of The World.

title: Space2Stats Database
summary: This database contains geospatial statistics for the entire globe standardized to a hexagonal grid. The variables cover a wide range of geographic themes relevant to international development, including demographic, socio-economic, environmental, climate, and infrastructure.

title: Super-Resolved Sentinel-2 2.5m STAC API
summary: Live search over the Copernicus Sentinel-2 L2A catalogue (STAC Core + Item Search). Every Item also exposes a paywalled 'sr' asset for ordering 2.5m AI super-resolved imagery over a custom AOI via the Semablu API. Free, unauthenticated browsing; SR orders need an API key and credits. See [API docs](https://console.semablu.com/api-docs).

title: Terrabyte Stac Api (Dlr)
summary: Curated data catalog of the terrabyte platform provided by DLR and LRZ
accessInfo: Access through DLR or LRZ, contact the [support](https://docs.terrabyte.lrz.de/support/support-resources/) for more details.

title: Terrascope
summary: Terrascope is the Belgian Earth Observation Data Space. It provides easy access to Copernicus, PROBA-V, and SPOT-VEGETATION satellite data, products, and services. The access is free and open to all registered users, see [documentation](https://docs.terrascope.be/).
accessInfo: You need to register yourself a Terrascope account at <https://portal.terrascope.be/home> and subscribe to a paid plan.

title: The Wildland Almanac - CONUS
summary: Root catalog for The Wildland Almanac - CONUS, a 30 m Landsat-derived data cube of wildland ecosystem properties at decadal snapshots (water years 1990, 2000, 2010, 2020, 2024). Each release is a complete reprocessing of the full snapshot set and is published as a versioned sub-catalog; the current release is v2026.1.

title: The Wildland Almanac - California
summary: Root catalog for The Wildland Almanac - California, a 30 m Landsat-derived data cube of wildland ecosystem properties spanning water years 1985-2025. Each annual release is a complete reprocessing of the full time series and is published as a versioned sub-catalog; the current release is v2026.1.

title: The Wildland Almanac - Treatment Scenarios
summary: Root catalog for The Wildland Almanac - Treatment Scenarios, a 30 m Landsat-derived data cube of wildland ecosystem properties for 24 BlueForest management-treatment scenarios applied to the 2024 western-CONUS baseline. Each release regenerates the full treatment set from the current baseline and is published as a versioned sub-catalog; the current release is v2026.1.

title: Thünen Earth Observation (ThEO)
summary: Open-access, satellite-based products for Germany, focusing on seasonal land cover, crop types, and grassland dynamics.

title: Trazo Field Boundaries of South America
summary: 10.9 million agricultural field boundaries across South America for the 2023–2024 planting season, delineated from Sentinel-2 imagery by the Trazo model suite (U-Net / EfficientNet-B3, built on Fields of The World). Published as three collections, one per model — trazo3-fields is recommended for most use cases. Intended to support supply chain traceability, EUDR compliance workflows, and field-level deforestation monitoring.

title: TriMet Geospatial Data
summary: A cloud-native mirror of the eight geospatial datasets TriMet publishes at [developer.trimet.org/gis](https://developer.trimet.org/gis/) — the transit district boundary, fixed-route alignments, rail lines, stops, route stops, rail stops, transit centers and park and rides for the Portland, Oregon metropolitan area.

title: UK NCEO Analysis Ready Data (ARD)
summary: This STAC catalog contains Sentinel 2 (S2) surface reflectance over the UK from 2017 to 2019. The surface reflectance have been processed by SIAC atmospheric correction method, with per pixel uncertainty information.

title: US GeoPlatform
summary: GeoPlatform.gov provides official list of National STAC Sources.

title: USGS 3DEP LiDAR Point Clouds
summary: LiDAR 3DEP elevation data over the conterminous United States, Hawaii, and the U.S. territories, acquired over an 8-year period. Hosted on AWS.

title: USGS Astrogeology Provided Analysis Ready Data
summary: Analysis Ready Data (ARD) hosted by USGS Astrogeology. This catalog is organized by planetary body (e.g., Mars or Jupiter). Within each sub-catalog, users will find ARD orgamized by moon and/or data type (e.g., Europa, or kaguyaTC DTMs) depending upon how much logical nesting is required.

title: USGS Landsat Collection 2 API
summary: USGS authoritative source for Landsat Collection 2 data

title: UVT STAC Catalog
summary: Spatio-Temporal Asset Catalog containing various geospatial products distributed by West University of Timisoara

title: Umbra Open SAR Data
summary: Umbra Open SAR Data available as part of the AWS Open Data program

title: United States : NGDA Transportation Theme Data
summary: United States : NGDA Transportation Theme : Collection

title: VITO (openEO)
summary: openEO API to the VITO Remote Sensing product catalog and processing services.
accessInfo: Contact [Jeroen Dries](https://remotesensing.vito.be/team/jeroen-dries) or [VITO Remote Sensing](https://remotesensing.vito.be/contact-us) for more information.

title: WeatherLayers
summary: WeatherLayers is Weather Visualization as a Service, providing pre-processed weather data for visualization and a frontend weather visualization library, which can be used with both cloud and custom self-hosted data. See [WeatherLayers](https://weatherlayers.com/) for more details.
accessInfo: Subscription plans are available to access periodically pre-processed weather data for visualization. See [WeatherLayers](https://weatherlayers.com/) for more details.

title: World Bank - Light Every Night
summary: Nightly visible radiance catalogues from VIIRS DNB NPP for 2012/04 through 2020/12.

title: WorldPop STAC API
summary: WorldPop STAC API is a platform for accessing and analysing WorldPop geospatial data. WorldPop develops peer-reviewed research and methods for the construction of open and high-resolution geospatial data on population distributions, demographic and  dynamics.

title: Wyvern Open Data
summary: Root catalog for Wyvern's Open Data Program. Select the relevant catalogs/collections to access Wyvern's hyperspectral data. For more information on Wyvern and our data, check out our [knowledge centre](https://knowledge.wyvern.space/) for tutorials about how to work with hyperspectral data!

title: 🇺🇸  United States | Disasters Community Data
summary: This site provides a unified environment for community partners to publish, share, and access authoritative geospatial data, applications, and resources related to the preparedness, response, recovery, and mitigation of disasters.

title: 🇺🇸 United States | Address Data Theme
summary: The Address Theme consists of the data elements, attributes, and metadata that specify a fixed geographic location by reference to a thoroughfare or landmark, or specify a point of postal delivery, or both.

title: 🇺🇸 United States | Alabama Geoportal Resources
summary: Alabama's Open Data Portal (ODP) is the states platform for exploring and downloading open data, discovering and building apps, and engaging the public through geospatial data. Inside Alabama's ODP, you can browse, search, preview, and download a variety of Alabama and national geospatial data.

title: 🇺🇸 United States | Alaska Geospatial Resources
summary: Alaska’s GeoPortal is the states platform for exploring and downloading open data, discovering and building apps, and engaging the public through geospatial data. The OGC Compliant API allows you to browse, search, preview, and download a variety of state and national geospatial data.

title: 🇺🇸 United States | Cadastre Data Theme
summary: Cadastre information from the U.S. Past, current, and future rights and interests in real property including the spatial information necessary to describe geographic extents.

title: 🇺🇸 United States | California Geospatial Data
summary: California’s GeoPortal is the states platform for exploring and downloading open data, discovering and building apps, and engaging the public through geospatial data. The OGC Compliant API allows you to browse, search, preview, and download a variety of state and national geospatial data.
